**rustler\_mix** is a project in [Tools](@/projects/tools.md). Its code is written mainly in [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md) (76.9 %), with [Erlang](@/glossary/erlang.md) and [Rust](@/glossary/rust.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created in October 2016; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 18 October 2016. It reads “New version of rustler\_mix”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2016, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/rustler_mix) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/rustler_mix).

Related work in [Tools](@/projects/tools.md): [mapoffacts](@/work/mapoffacts.md) (2017), [zaas](@/work/zaas.md) (2017), [astudo](@/work/astudo.md) (2022) and [charon](@/work/charon.md) (2016).
